title: The external test runner still retains a subprocess fallback
observed_need: Run a suite and its entries while preserving one compiler/runtime session, shared provenance, and bounded setup state.
current_language_behavior: mncs-embed now exposes Artifact/Session and a stable batch C ABI. A current six-entry mncs-test-self run compiles once, opens one retained session, and executes one batch with six distinct observations. CLI launch and the no-library fallback remain.
why_insufficient: The external runner cannot remove compiler process launch, result transport, or the compatibility fallback until those boundaries have a native replacement and every affected consumer migrates.
minimal_reproducer: A current mncs-test-self run records execution.mode=retained-embed-batch, batch_size=6, session.reused_session=true; remove the shared library to reproduce the explicit subprocess-per-test fallback.
desired_direction: A versioned batch/session execution API that keeps native values and fixtures in one bounded runtime while preserving per-test identity and isolation controls.
workaround: The normal path uses one compiler invocation plus one retained mncs-embed session and batch; Python preserves requests/results and uses one subprocess per entry only when the embed boundary is unavailable.
